title: backnotprop/plannotator
text: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click. https://plannotator.ai Everything you need to annotate and stay in the loop with your agents Inbox Surface • Artifacts • Code Review Annotate plans, specs, markdown, HTML, and other interactive artifacts. Review diffs and PRs. Send feedback to your agent. Plannotator Inbox · Official site · Code Review · Visual HTML Skills · Herdr Annotate · (Legacy) Plan Mode Plannotator ⭐️ NEW: Plannotator Inbox is the missing layer between you and managing multi-agent work. Plannotator is a local, browser-based review surface for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kiro, Droid, Amp, DeepSeek Harness, and Pi. It plugs directly into your agent through its hooks and commands. When the agent proposes a plan, html, or finishes writing code, the work opens in your browser and you mark it up, comment, and send feedback directly to the agent for it to act on it.
